test_ArrowFileIterator_basic: test the ArrowFileIterator by iterating over an Arrow file and verifying sample IDs match expected values
test_ArrowFileIterator_resume: test resuming an ArrowFileIterator from a specific row number past the initial batch size
test_ArrowFileIterator_sharding: test ArrowFileIterator worker sharding by verifying each worker receives only its assigned rows
test_read_jsonl_from_arrow: test reading JSONL format files through the ArrowFileIterator and verifying sample text content
test_ArrowFileIteratorState_build: test building an ArrowFileIterator from an ArrowFileIteratorState and verifying the initial row number
